scope: Seventeen result-specific representative records in main Tables IV–V; current artifact inspection is distinct from historical experiment identity.
e1_threshold: Archival quantitative finding with an identifiable public result-specific implementation, workload/model configuration, comparator where applicable and scoring/measurement route supporting rerun in principle. No independent rerun or exact historical identity is implied.
e2_threshold: Inspectable quantitative result with incomplete or unverified result-specific replication path, irrespective of publication.
selection: Purposive coverage of controls, execution tiers and outcome types; not exhaustive or a reconstructed screening flow.

composite_row_rule: A row invoking several material outcomes takes the least-established replication path among them. Publication maturity is part of the grade; task outcome type and mobile transfer are assessed separately.
